newsitem.title: USA: American Greetings has higher quarter, to sell units.
newsitem.headline: American Greetings has higher quarter, to sell units.

text.p: American Greetings Corp. on Thursday reported higher first-quarter earnings on the strength of its core greeting card business and said it agreed to sell its Acme Frame Products and Wilhold subsidiaries to Newell Co.

The Cleveland-based company earned $30.3 million, or 40 cents a share, on sales of $475.1 million in the first quarter ended May 31, compared with profits of $13.9 million, or 37 cents a share, on sales of $438.2 million.
American Greetings' earnings were in line with analysts' expectations, according to the First Call service.

The largest publicly held greeting card company also said it plans to repurchase up to 4.5 million shares of its stock, or about 6 percent of the current 75.2 million shares outstanding, on the open market. It did not set a time frame for the buybacks.

Terms of the subsidiary sale were not disclosed, but American Greetings said the spinoff of its two subsidiaries would generate a one-time pretax gain of about $22 million, which will be about $14 million after taxes, or 18 cents a share.
Acme Frame Products is a manufacturer and distributor of picture frames. Wilhold manufactures and distributes women's hair care accessories.
American Greetings said it expected the deal to close in the next several months. The transaction is subject to customary conditions, including Hart-Scott-Rodino approval, the company added.

Part of the gain from the transaction will offset some expenses associated with preparing the company's computer systems for "Year 2000" requirements. This programme continues to evaluate appropriate solutions and is expected to continue for the next two years.
First-quarter results were driven by the continued strength of its greeting card business, said company President Ed Fruchtenbaum.

Chief Executive Morry Weiss said he expects American Greetings will report net earnings of $2.50 to $2.60 per share in its current fiscal year ending March 31,1998, up from $2.23 per share a year earlier.
American Greetings stock was up 43.75 cents at $35.5625 in morning trading on Nasdaq.
